calls.reason: Slack pricing and Zylo's purchasing research support premium costs and budget caution. They do not settle the subjective value judgment or establish that the add-ons are interchangeable.
Salesforce's Agentforce announcement shows AI commercialization, while Apple's announcement shows another route to adoption. Neither establishes what predominantly drove the industry's AI commitment.

Bain reports substantial added inference costs but also falling costs per unit of work; Anthropic describes caching savings. This mixed evidence does not settle the claimed rising-cost burden on SaaS revenue.
Workday and Box show generic drafting features, and OpenAI documents free writing assistance. These examples do not establish near-universal prevalence or free equivalents for every listed task.
Salesforce describes planning and action execution, but the packet has no verified comparison with earlier chatbots. Its announcement alone cannot establish either substantive novelty or equivalence.

Figma's CFO attributes margin pressure to AI costs, and its results show gross margin falling from 92% to 86%. That supports margin erosion in one firm, but the broader price-rise or withdrawal prediction remains hedged and unestablished.
